title: From Tokens to Policy: Causal and Interpretable Heterogeneous Treatment Effects Identification
abstract: arXiv:2606.17010v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Heterogeneous Treatment Effect (HTE) identification is essential to explain the impact of an intervention and optimize our policies accordingly. Existing approaches trade expressivity for interpretability, but, if some active heterogeneity drivers are unmeasured, methods at both ends of this spectrum allow for spurious HTE characterization with no causal reading. In this work, we focus on controlled experiments and argue that an oracle HTE causal characterization via the latent interactors is now within reach, thanks to (i) more extensive pre-treatment measurements, i.e., multi-modal and multi-view, and (ii) scalable representations with minimal human supervision. We then re-frame HTE identification as a Markov-blanket discovery problem on a sufficient and aligned pre-treatment representation, and introduce Neural EXposure Interaction Search (NEXIS), an iterative procedure with a provable selection guarantee. translated_title: 从标记到策略：因果且可解释的异质性处理效应识别
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2606.17010v2，公告类型：替换）：异质性处理效应（HTE）识别对于解释干预措施的影响并据此优化政策至关重要。现有方法在表达能力与可解释性之间进行权衡，但如果某些活跃的异质性驱动因素未被测量，处于该谱系两端的方法都可能产生没有因果解读意义的虚假HTE刻画。在本工作中，我们聚焦于受控实验，并论证通过潜在交互因子实现“神谕级”HTE因果刻画如今已触手可及，这得益于：（i）更广泛的处理前测量，即多模态和多视角测量，以及（ii）具有最少人工监督的可扩展表示。随后，我们将HTE识别重新构建为在充分且对齐的处理前表示上的马尔可夫毯发现问题，并提出了神经暴露交互搜索（NEXIS），这是一种具有可证明选择保证的迭代程序。我们将NEXIS部署在两个……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出NEXIS方法，将异质性处理效应识别重新构建为充分且对齐的处理前表示上的马尔可夫毯发现问题，利用多模态多视角数据实现因果且可解释的HTE识别，并具有可证明的选择保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NEXIS, which reformulates heterogeneous treatment effect identification as a Markov blanket discovery problem over sufficient and aligned pre-treatment representations, enabling causal and interpretable HTE identification with provable selection guarantees.
